scope: The standing Grade II listed All Saints’ Church on Raleigh Street, including its broach spire, stair turret, nave and aisles, transepts, porches and apsidal chancel.

originalReview.notes: Shows the main west steeple, its buttresses, the three-light bell stage, two lucarne tiers, the nave roof and the contrast between gray-brown wall stone and light dressings.
Only the church’s tower and adjoining dark church roof in the upper background inform this model. The lower school building, walls and chimneys are separate.

quallaSearch.notes: The lead image retains Andrewrabbott’s named en.wikipedia public-domain dedication and original upload record. The second is an exact CC0 original by Simon Cobb. Unrelated photographs of the school, vicarage and council house are outside the model references.
